annotations.title: List B.R.M watches in stock, ready to ship

description: Lists the B.R.M watches that are in stock and ship right away, as listed on brm-chronographes.com: name, reference, collection, price in the billing currency of the DELIVERY country (French VAT inside the EU, 0% VAT outside the EU with duties payable by the buyer; same rule as quote_configuration), image, product page link (product_url, where the user can buy the watch) and the delivery window B.R.M publishes for watches in stock, which is an estimate and not a fixed delivery date. Watches already sold or reserved are not listed. Optional filters: collection or model name, and max_price in the billing currency. Prices are indicative; the checkout on brm-chronographes.com is authoritative.

collection.description: Optional collection or model name, e.g. 'V6', 'GF7', 'BM6', 'V6-44'.

country.description: Delivery country, ISO-3166 alpha-2, e.g. 'US'. Sets the currency and VAT of the prices.

max_price.description: Optional maximum price, in the billing currency of the delivery country.

name: list_in_stock_watches

lead_time.description: The delivery window published for watches in stock (an estimate, not a fixed date), with the delivery page `url`.

total_matching.description: Models in stock matching the filters, before `limit`.

price_before_discount.description: Present when a promotion shown on the site applies.

title: List B.R.M watches in stock, ready to ship
